name: Offutt AFB
description: Home of U.S. Strategic Command and the 55th Wing. Offutt AFB provides global ISR, strategic deterrence support, and is a major intelligence and reconnaissance hub.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: STRATCOM Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 gate. After-hours visitor passes when VCC closed.

gates.name: Kenney (Flag) Gate
gates.notes: Primary visitor gate off Fort Crook Rd.
gates.address: Fort Crook Rd, Offutt AFB, NE 68113

gates.name: Bellevue Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed federal holidays, ACC Family Days, and Wing Goal Days

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1600; closed federal holidays, ACC Family Days, and Wing Goal Days

resources.name: Ronald L. King Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC closed for renovations and transition to Air Force Food 2.0. Will reopen as campus-style dining open to all DoD ID cardholders.
resources.hours: Currently closed for renovations — follow 55 FSS for reopening updates

resources.name: Offutt Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Offutt Main Exchange with food court (Charley's, Anthony's Pizza), barber, beauty shop, optical, GNC, dry cleaning, and Class Six.

resources.name: Cobalt Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Offutt Field House
resources.description: Largest fitness center in DoD with 0.4-mile track, racquetball, tactical fitness, tennis, soccer, basketball, indoor pool, and group fitness.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2100; Sat-Sun 0700-1700; 24/7 CAC access after registration

resources.name: Air Force Inns (Offutt Inns)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and family quarters. 24-hour front desk and continental breakfast.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, EFMP, school liaison, and family programs.

resources.name: 55th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Peacekeeper Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: 20-lane bowling center in Martin Bomber Building basement with Kegler Kafe snack bar and cosmic bowling weekends.
resources.address: 106 Peacekeeper Dr, Bldg D, Offutt AFB, NE 68113

resources.name: Willow Lakes Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop open year-round.

resources.name: 55th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Air Force Inns (402-281-1292) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Rising View Community.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 55 FSS, M&FRC, and official Offutt sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
